R1D-grouse-atv-0001.name: 470 m W of Tsulton River
R1D-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R1D-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
10 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: sooty (blue) and ruffed only; 5 each (15 each); no open season on Denman Island (page 20)
sooty (blue) and ruffed; Bow Only; 5 each (15 each); no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)
No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 165 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.46901, -126.95564, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 100 m to the start. Ride: the Railway stretch, 3.7 km one way. About 75 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-11, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-11: about 3,078 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.32 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
